description: This Java class 'DefaultAuthenticationResult' implements the 'AuthenticationResult' interface, representing the outcome of an authentication process with either success (including an authorization context) or failure (with a reason). It includes factory methods for success and failure cases and provides accessors for the contained data.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationResult
classes.description: A final class implementing AuthenticationResult, encapsulating the headers, optional authorization context, and optional failure reason, indicating either success or failure of authentication.

methods.name: successful
methods.description: Creates an instance representing a successful authentication, containing the provided AuthorizationContext.

methods.name: failed
methods.description: Creates an instance representing a failed authentication, containing the reason for failure.

methods.name: isSuccess
methods.description: Checks if the authentication result was successful.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the AuthorizationContext if authentication was successful; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with the authentication result.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailure
methods.description: Returns the Throwable indicating reason for failure; throws if authentication was successful.
